text.facebook: Fireworks season has started, and Bonfire Night is Thursday 5 November. Dogs Trust's advice is to walk your dog in daylight and be home well before the bangs begin, with doors, windows and fences checked so a frightened dog can't bolt. If your dog really struggles, the BVA says talk to your vet early. My tip: move the walk earlier this week. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/fireworks-and-dogs
